riskRules: Fund actions must not imply guaranteed settlement or risk-free movement.
permissions: Visible to signed-in trading account users; action handlers decide eligibility.

riskRules: Destructive or high-risk actions must carry explicit copy and tone in the caller.
permissions: Caller controls visibility based on role and account state.

riskRules: Account status must remain visible when selecting an account.
permissions: Signed-in user with trading account access.

riskRules: High-risk trading, funding, security, and account actions must expose explicit cancel and confirm paths.
Confirm actions must be registered in modalRegistry with risk level, close behavior, and confirm behavior.
permissions: Caller owns role, account, and entitlement checks before opening the confirmation.
qaGate: No Alert.alert or window.confirm for governed flows

riskRules: Close-position and order mutations must use registered confirmation or feedback flows.
permissions: Trader role plus production account and order entitlement checks.
qaGate: Uses Card, KeyValueList, TradeOrderList, GlobalMenuList, ConfirmActionSheet, and ToastProvider instead of page-local primitives

riskRules: Order direction, quantity, price/range, and P/L or status values must remain visible and text-based for auditability.
permissions: Caller controls account scope, order entitlement, and mutation permissions.
qaGate: Uses TradeDirectionIcon sizeVariant instead of raw icon size
No page-local trading order row loops
No row-level horizontal padding; outer container controls list width
Registered edge-to-edge exception; do not restore row-level or card-level horizontal padding

riskRules: Ledger data must remain textual and auditable; charts are supplemental only.
permissions: Trader role plus production account ownership and ledger scope checks.
qaGate: Uses registered DetailRow, KeyValueList, TransactionRow, MiniBarChart, StatusPill, and BottomSheet presets

riskRules: Deposit, withdrawal, and transfer flows must keep fees, FX, eligibility, and recovery feedback visible.
permissions: Trader role plus production KYC, jurisdiction, limit, account, and payout eligibility checks.
qaGate: Uses TextField, SelectField, TradingAccountSwitchSheet, FundActionGrid, TransactionRow, funding feedback toast, and default-tone IconSurface backgrounds for form selector left icons

riskRules: Trading entry must route through order ticket and must not bypass quote/account entitlement checks.
permissions: Trader role plus production quote entitlement and trading account checks.
qaGate: Uses registered InstrumentIcon, HeaderIconButton, AppIcon, and order ticket route modal

riskRules: Partner upgrade state must not be overstated as approval before approved status.
permissions: Shown according to role and upgrade request status.

riskRules: Screens may orchestrate business actions but must not define reusable uppercase UI in app routes.
permissions: Route and store guards own access rules.
